title: Cô gái có 6 múi chỉ sau 8 tuần — Không dùng steroid, không phẫu thuật
script: 8 tuần trước: bụng mỡ, không có gì ngoài undefined softness. 8 tuần sau: rõ ràng 6 múi. Cô ấy làm gì? Bài tập: Plank 3 phút/ngày, bicycle crunches 50 reps, leg raises 30 reps, mountain climbers 2 phút. Dinh dưỡng: protein 1.6g per kg body weight, carb chỉ từ gạo lứt và yến mạch, cắt đường hoàn toàn. Bí quyết thực sự: consistency. Không phải tập nặng. Mà là tập đều. 8 tuần — có thể thay đổi hoàn toàn definition của bạn. Không cần gym. Không cần máy. Chỉ cần sàn nhà và ý chí.
prompt_for_hailuo: Week 1: girl lying down, soft undefined stomach with visible fat layer [Close up]. Week 8: same girl doing ab reveal, lifted sports bra showing clear 6-pack abs definition [Medium shot]. Ab exercises montage: plank hold at 3 minutes, bicycle crunches with perfect form, leg raises slow and controlled, mountain climbers high speed [Dynamic tracking montage]. Nutrition split: protein foods glowing on left, sugar crossed out in red on right [Animated graphic]. 8-week calendar countdown animation, each week ticking off [Macro shot]. Strong confident ab pose on beach, athletic physique [Wide cinematic shot]. Dramatic transformation lighting, strong contrast shadows on abs, empowering epic feel, cinematic portrait 9:16.
thumbnail_idea: 8-week ab transformation — soft undefined stomach on left vs clear 6-pack on right
visual_scene: A dramatic transformation timeline sequence set in a modern gym with cinematic dramatic lighting: starting with week 1 showing a Vietnamese fitness girl lying down with a soft undefined stomach clearly visible, then an animated 8-week calendar countdown ticking through each week with determination showing in her eyes at each checkpoint, culminating in week 8 with the same girl dramatically pulling up her sports bra to reveal clearly defined 6-pack abs with dramatic side lighting creating sharp shadows between each ab muscle. A dynamic exercise montage shows: a perfect plank held at exactly 3 minutes with abs rock solid, slow controlled leg raises showing lower ab engagement, fast mountain climbers with full hip extension, and textbook bicycle crunches with elbows touching opposite knees. An animated nutrition split graphic shows protein-rich foods glowing green on the left while sugar in a red circle with a line through it dominates the right. Final shot: the same athletic girl standing confidently on a beach in a sports bikini showing her full athletic 6-pack physique with dramatic golden hour light sculpting every ab muscle, portrait 9:16 framing.
negative_prompt: generic anime or cartoon style, animated or illustrated characters, distorted hands or fingers, blurry or low resolution output, text overlays or captions, logos or watermarks, still or static frame, landscape orientation, dark dull gym, sad unmotivated expression, fast food visible, juice or soda bottles, cheap supplement containers
specific_details: Modern gym with cinematic dramatic lighting, Vietnamese fitness girl week 1 with soft undefined stomach lying down, animated 8-week countdown calendar ticking through each week, week 8 ab reveal with sports bra lifted showing clear 6-pack with dramatic side shadows, plank at 3 minutes with rock solid abs, leg raises slow controlled, mountain climbers fast with hip extension, bicycle crunches elbows to opposite knees, animated nutrition split: protein foods green glow left vs sugar crossed out red right, final beach shot athletic 6-pack physique in golden hour light, portrait 9:16.
